checks.name: phase_h_files_exist
command: test -f Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.h && test -f Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.h && test -f Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.h && test -f Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/MonoGuard.h && test -f Source/DSP/MonoGuard.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.h && test -f Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.cpp && test -f tests/MidSideTests.cpp && test -f tests/LookaheadTests.cpp

checks.name: cmake_lists_lists_phase_h_sources
command: rg -q "MidSideRouter\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "SidechainAnalyzer\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "MaskingCarver\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "MonoGuard\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "LookaheadDelay\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "MidSideTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "LookaheadTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: midside_router_encode_decode_and_side_hpf
command: rg -q "encode|Encode|decode|Decode|Mid|Side" Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.h Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.cpp && rg -q "HighPass|highPass|HPF|sideHighPass|120|300" Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.h Source/DSP/MidSideRouter.cpp

checks.name: sidechain_masking_metric_and_carver
command: rg -q "Overlap|Dominance|Masking|ERB|octave" Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.h Source/DSP/SidechainAnalyzer.cpp && rg -q "G_carve|carve|Carve|suggestion|Suggestion|G_max|threshold" Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.h Source/DSP/MaskingCarver.cpp

checks.name: lookahead_modes_and_latency_api
command: rg -q "0\.5|1|2|5|LookaheadMode|getLatencySamples" Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.h Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.cpp && rg -q "circular|delay|crossfade|Crossfade|buffer" Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.h Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.cpp

checks.name: plugin_processor_phase_h_wiring
command: rg -q "MidSideRouter|SidechainAnalyzer|MaskingCarver|MonoGuard|LookaheadDelay" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && rg -q "setLatencySamples" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
